channel.title: FlowNarrate
channel.description: Automation, AI agents and business systems explained in plain English: the reasoning behind each step, not just the steps.

item.title: Filling in a whole Microsoft Form at once, with a pre-filled link
item.description: Pasting answers into a Microsoft Form one box at a time is slow with a screen reader. Pre-filled links load every answer at once. How the link works for each question type, the hidden space that silently blanks an answer, and a tool that lets an AI write the link.

item.title: Sending email from a mailbox nobody can sign in to
item.description: A shared Dataverse mailbox (do-not-reply, notifications, accounts) needs to send email, but no one signs into it. Two errors you'll hit setting this up, and the second one needs the Web API, not the UI.

item.title: An approval flow, narrated: why each step exists, and where it breaks
item.description: A composite expense-claim approval flow, walked step by step: what each action does, why the threshold and escalation exist, and where flows like this quietly break.

item.title: What is FlowNarrate?
item.description: Why automation logic deserves to be told as clearly as it was built.
